metadata.title: Evaluate Deployment Result
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Evaluate the CD pipeline outcome, extract failure details if deployment failed, and decide whether to proceed, retry (loop back to implementation), or report that the retry cap has been reached. Failure details are stored in memory so the implementation step can target the fix on retry.

output.description: Deployment decision: proceed (passed), retry (loop back to implementation), or cap-reached (log warning and proceed)

prerequisites: Monitor Deployment step completed (cdPipelineStatus in memory)
cdPipelineRunId available in memory for log retrieval
specificActions: If passed: record success, set cdDecision to 'passed', proceed
If failed: read build logs via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build_log
Extract actionable error details: error messages, failing stage, stack traces
Categorize failure: deployment config error, application startup failure, health check failure, environment issue, infrastructure failure, timeout
If retries < max: set cdDecision to 'retry', store failure context for implementation step
If retries >= max: set cdDecision to 'cap-reached', log warning with unresolved issues
Include which environments were affected in the failure details
tools: mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build_log - Read build/deployment logs on failure
bestPractices: Always categorize the failure type — different categories need different fix approaches
Extract the most relevant failure information for the implementation step
Provide actionable context: what failed, in which environment, with what error
On retry, failure details must be comprehensive enough for targeted fixes
On cap-reached, clearly document what remains unresolved and which environments are affected
Distinguish between infrastructure failures (may resolve on retry) and code failures (need implementation fix)
Track cdTargetEnvironments to know which environments succeeded vs failed

substeps.name: Check Deployment Status
substeps.description: Read the pipeline outcome from memory
actions: Read cdPipelineStatus from memory
Read cdEnvironmentStatuses for per-environment results
If succeeded → skip to substep 4 (record success)
If failed, canceled, or timeout → proceed to substep 1

substeps.name: Extract Failure Details
substeps.description: Read build logs and extract actionable error information
actions: Only execute if cdPipelineStatus is not 'succeeded'
Read build logs from the failing stage via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build_log
Extract: error messages, failing deployment stage, stack traces, health check results
Identify which environment(s) failed and which succeeded
Summarize failure in a format the implementation step can act on

substeps.name: Categorize Failure
substeps.description: Classify the failure type for appropriate handling
actions: Only execute if deployment failed
Categorize into one of:
- deployment_config_error: Pipeline config or parameter issues
- application_startup_failure: App fails to start in target environment
- health_check_failure: App starts but health checks fail
- environment_issue: Target environment is unhealthy or misconfigured
- infrastructure_failure: Agent, network, or platform issues
- timeout: Pipeline exceeded time limit
Record category in cdFailureDetails

substeps.name: Check Retry Count
substeps.description: Determine if retry is available based on maxDeploymentRetries
actions: Only execute if deployment failed
Read cdRetryIteration from memory (default 0)
Compare against maxDeploymentRetries parameter (default 3)
If retries < max: retry is available
If retries >= max: retry cap reached

substeps.name: Make Decision and Store Results
substeps.description: Set cdDecision and store all relevant details in memory
actions: If pipeline succeeded:
Set cdDecision to 'passed'
Record which environments deployed successfully
If pipeline failed AND retries available:
Set cdDecision to 'retry'
Increment cdRetryIteration
Store cdFailureDetails with category, errors, affected environments
Failure details must be actionable for the implementation step
If pipeline failed AND cap reached:
Set cdDecision to 'cap-reached'
Log warning: what's still failing and which environments affected
Store cdFailureDetails for post-process review
Record cdTargetEnvironments with final status per environment

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Check deployment status → Extract failure details (if failed) → Categorize failure → Check retry count → Decision: passed (proceed) / retry (loop back to implementation) / cap-reached (log warning, proceed)

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Deployment monitoring results (cdPipelineStatus, cdEnvironmentStatuses, cdPipelineRunId), deploy config, retry iteration state
fields: Information Produced: cdFailureDetails (category, error messages, affected environments, actionable summary), cdDecision (passed/retry/cap-reached), cdRetryIteration (updated count), cdTargetEnvironments (per-environment final status)
Decisions Made: Failure categorization, retry vs proceed decision with justification
